Okunoonya okufuna ebingi, kubalabankanyizza (ne kubaggya ku kugondera Amateeka ga Allah).
Nedda, kyaddsaki mujja kumanya (mu kiseera ky'okufa)
Oluvanyuma era kyaddaki mujja kumanya (nga muyingidde kabbuli).
Nedda, singa mubadde mumanyi mu bukakafu bw'okumanya (temwandirabankanyiziddwa na kukuŋŋaanya bingi)
oluvannyuma era Omuliro ogwo mujja kugulaba mugutegeerere ddala.
Ate ddala oluvanyuma mugenda kubuuzibwa ku byengera bye mwafuna ku nsi (mwabifuna mu makubo ki, era mwabisaasaanya mu makubo ki).
